CIV.note: States no AI-specific law; general digital laws are said to apply by extension, with no rule or authority on AI harms named.
No government AI system is described.

facts.fact: Digital Mag reports digital-law expert Dr Ibrahim Coulibaly saying at a 11 March 2026 conference that Cote d'Ivoire has no AI-specific law and relies on soft law over existing digital texts.

CIV.note: No sector AI system is described.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is described.

facts.fact: Digital Mag reports the conference listing a personal data protection law among the texts already in force that require respect for privacy and confidentiality of data collected.

CIV.note: The national AI strategy is said to rest on digital sovereignty, with no rule or plan on state data stated.

facts.fact: Digital Mag reports Law No. 2013-546 of 30 July 2013 on electronic transactions as framing digital exchanges and imposing security obligations.

CIV.note: Nothing stated on school internet or the secondary curriculum.
Only the EU's sandboxes for startups are mentioned; nothing for Cote d'Ivoire.
